title: GlobalProtect pointed at the old portal address

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
GlobalProtect will not connect from home - it tries for a while and then says
'Network error'. My home internet is fine, I am on a video call on the same
wifi right now.

The portal box says vpn.northgate-services.example, which is what I have always
had in there.

Aisha

must_include.what: Give the correct portal address, vpn.northgate.example

must_not_include.what: Sends her to IT for a certificate reissue, which is a different error
Blames a captive portal when she has said her wifi works

characteristics: Leads with the portal address: step 1 of the runbook, and she has quoted the wrong one
One correction, not the whole five-step list

rationale: She has put the answer in the ticket without knowing it. Step 1 of the VPN runbook calls a wrong or old portal address the single most common cause, and the address she quotes is not the one the runbook gives. Remote and cut off from everything internal with no workaround, so P2 (G1). The two must_not_include entries are the runbook's other branches, both of which would send her somewhere useless.
